title: Some days I like it others I dont.
text: Some days I like it others I dont.. Its loud. It creates a cold draft. It does work fairly well. Its kind of a pain in the butt to clean. I run it 24 hours a day and after two weeks I did my first bi weekly cleaning and the filter was yellow and looked to have some mold starting to grow . I soaked the filter in bleach and water and it basically ruined the filter. Looked on amazon and the filters are $14. Looks like every few weeks i'm gonna need a new filter. When you factor in a new filter every 3 weeks this isn't such a great bargain.

product_metadata.title: AIRCARE MA Whole-House Console-Style Evaporative Humidifier (Mini-Console)
features: The Mini-Console includes an adjustable humidistat, auto shutoff, refill indicator, and check filter indicator.
Digital humidistat automatically maintains your desired humidity level with digital accuracy
Automatically shuts off when desired humidity level is reached or when unit is empty
Easy to clean - evaporative wick traps mineral deposits, Smooth operation - no belts, pulleys or wheels
